item.title: Uonuma Koshihikari: Japan's Most Prized Rice & Hands-On Rice Farming — Guide
item.description: Uonuma Koshihikari, grown in the mountain-ringed Uonuma region of southern Niigata, is widely regarded as Japan’s finest rice, its exceptional sweetness and texture attributed to the region’s cold, snowmelt-fed irrigation water, wide daily temperature swings, and mineral-rich soil. The rice commands premium prices nationwide, and local farms across the region offer hands-on seasonal experiences — transplanting seedlings by hand in spring and harvesting by sickle in autumn — that let visitors participate directly in the cultivation of Japan’s most celebrated rice.
